name: openreadout
description: Read raw lab-instrument files without the vendor software: metadata, integrity checks, analyses and open-format export, as a skill and an MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Read raw files from microscopes, mass spectrometers, chromatographs, flow cytometers, NMR and IR/Raman spectrometers, electrophysiology rigs, plate readers and qPCR machines without the vendor software. Get metadata, previews, integrity checks and the usual analyses, and export to OME-TIFF, OME-Zarr, mzML, Parquet, NWB and other open formats. Runs locally with the openreadout program on your PATH, makes no network connections, and never modifies the files it reads.
defaultPrompt: What is in this instrument file, and how was it acquired?
Check whether these files are intact.
